description.zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。</ph></props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
Instance ID.<props="china"><ph>You can view the current instance **ID** on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>  

><notice>  
- If an ID exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the invocation fails.  
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify it.  

></notice>  

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh:
要查询的设备名列表。
><notice>每个设备的 **ProductKey**与**DeviceName**必须同时传入，且设备个数不能超过20个。
></notice>
description.en:
List of device names to query.  
><notice>For each device, you must specify both **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, and the number of devices cannot exceed 20.  
></notice>

description.zh:
要查询设备所属产品的ProductKey列表。
ProductKey是物联网平台为新建产品颁发的全局唯一标识符。您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)，查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
><notice>每个设备的 **ProductKey**与**DeviceName**必须同时传入，且设备个数不能超过20个。
></notice>
description.en:
The ProductKey list of the products to which the devices belong.  
ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by the IoT Platform for a newly created product. You can view information about all products under your account in the IoT Platform console or by calling [QueryProductList](~~69271~~).  
><notice>For each device, you must specify both **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, and the number of devices cannot exceed 20.  
></notice>

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为50。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS Limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API is 50 per Alibaba Cloud account.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot gis-query-device-location --thing-list ProductKey=g3r0000Vjta DeviceName=mock_device_name --iot-instance-id iot-a000013l --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot GisQueryDeviceLocation --region cn-hangzhou --ThingList.1.DeviceName mock_device_name --IotInstanceId 'iot-a000013l' --ThingList.1.ProductKey g3r0000Vjta
